name: still-mods
description: Personal mods for Claude Code: plan progress bars, usage meters and an Agents pane

planProgress.title: Plan progress bars
planProgress.description: Progress bars for multi-step tasks, with the plan_progress tool and the /progress commands

planEnforcement.title: Plan bar enforcement
planEnforcement.description: strict: refuse changes and send the turn back until the bar is updated; soft: reminders only; off: bars only when Claude finds them useful

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Sounds when a bar waits for a decision, fails or finishes: soft (still-mods' own), classic (plan-progress'), or off

agentsPane.title: Agents pane
agentsPane.description: The subagents of the session and the team journal: auto opens it when an agent starts, manual with /still-mods-agents, off

agentsSessionsDir.title: Team session folders
agentsSessionsDir.description: Folder of the team's session folders, from the project root; the newest one's journal.md is shown

usageMeters.title: Usage meters
usageMeters.description: Context, 5-hour and weekly limit meters at the bottom of the band

timeZone.title: Reset time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the 5-hour reset time, such as Europe/Paris

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels' language: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
